description: Unsigned transactions for one credit risk action, checked against the contract for this wallet. Guarantor: cover (offer on a tranche at a yearly premium), withdraw_offer, collect (premium and interest), sell, unlist, buy, release (after the end), contest (a signed claim, with its bond). Credit company or firm: verify_entity (LEI and official domain, once a year). Credit company: publish (from its public anonymous loan file; the publication fee to Sjothr is allowed first), close_offers, cancel, pay_premium, file_claim (loans in default from the loan file, with the public claim dossier), withdraw_claim, file_report (quarterly report), return_recovery, take_back_premium, replace_firm (when its firm was disowned). Verification firm: sign_engagement (with its EAS business attestation), attest, file_claim (signed at once), sign_claim, refuse_claim, sign_report. Juror (read sjothr_code first): vote (four findings, hidden: keep your salt and reasons), reveal (the same findings, with the reasons). Anyone: pay_claim, resolve, end. To be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet; nothing is signed or sent by this server.

attestation.description: Id of the EAS entity attestation issued to this wallet by a recognized verifier, obtained with verify_entity (publish, sign_engagement)

bookDefaultPercent.description: Share in default over the same period of all the company's loans of the same kind, in percent (file_report)

criteriaUri.description: Public address of the fixed criteria that selected the loans, not their quality (publish)

defaultDays.description: Days unpaid that make a loan a default (publish)

domain.description: Official domain of the company, whose certificate names it and which publishes /.well-known/sjothr.json (verify_entity)

findings.description: The juror's four findings under Sjothr's code, each true (established by the published record) or false (not established, or in doubt), the same for vote and reveal; the contract computes the verdict: founded only if all four are true (vote, reveal)

default.description: Article 10: For every loan, does the dossier show the borrower missed a payment on the stated date and has not cured it since, for at least the portfolio's unpaid days (no restructuring, extension or forgiveness)?

eligible.description: Article 11: Did every loan meet the published lending criteria when granted, and was it current on the day the portfolio was published?

goodFaith.description: Article 13: Did the company neither cause, arrange nor hasten the default (no related or fictitious borrower, no loan made to fail, no default caused by its own failure), hide no recovery, and carry out normal collection?

loss.description: Article 12: Is each loss the principal outstanding at default minus every repayment, recovery and realised collateral, with no interest, penalty, fee or cost?

firm.description: Address of an eligible verification firm (publish, replace_firm), listed as verifiedFirms by sjothr_tribunal

firstLossPercent.description: Share of the loan book the company keeps first, in percent (publish)

hash.description: keccak256 of the same document's bytes, 0x and 64 hex digits (file_claim, file_report, sign_engagement, attest)

lei.description: LEI of the company, active in the GLEIF register (verify_entity)

lendingPercent.description: Share of USDC guarantees CantorFi may lend, fixed for life (publish)

licence.description: Regulator and licence number of the credit company (attest)

loans.description: Loans of the claim: number in the loan file, total loss in USDC for this loan, first unpaid day YYYY-MM-DD (file_claim)

loansUri.description: Public HTTPS, IPFS or Arweave address of the anonymous loan file, CSV loan_id,principal_usdc,rate_bps,maturity,status (publish)

poolDefaultPercent.description: Share of the portfolio's principal in default over the period, in percent, 0 allowed (file_report)

poolId.description: Portfolio id (every action on a portfolio)

positionId.description: Position id (collect, sell, unlist, buy, release)

premium.description: Yearly premium asked, in percent, for example 11.5 (cover)

reasons.description: Written reasons, 4000 bytes at most: for each finding, true or false, the article of the code and the document that ground it, with the precise fact. Published with the findings at reveal (vote, reveal)

salt.description: Secret 0x and 64 hex digits chosen by the juror, the same for vote and reveal (vote, reveal)

signature.description: The wallet's signature (personal_sign) of the statement returned by verify_entity without signature (verify_entity)

uri.description: Public address of the claim dossier, the quarterly report or the engagement (file_claim, file_report, sign_engagement)

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send
